mapper.select: select r.*, case when r.resource_type='ROLE' then exists(select 1 from sys_role role where role.role_key=r.resource_code and role.status='0' and role.del_flag='0') else exists(select 1 from sys_dict_type type where type.dict_type=r.resource_code and type.status='0') end resource_exists, case when r.resource_type='ROLE' then (select count(*) from sys_role role where role.role_key=r.resource_code and role.status='0' and role.del_flag='0') else (select count(*) from sys_dict_data data where data.dict_type=r.resource_code and data.status='0') end active_item_count, coalesce(json_length(r.expected_values_json),0) expected_item_count, case when r.resource_type='ROLE' then 0 else (select count(*) from json_table(coalesce(r.expected_values_json,json_array()), '$[*]' columns( expected_value varchar(100) character set utf8mb4 collate utf8mb4_unicode_ci path '$.value', expected_label varchar(100) character set utf8mb4 collate utf8mb4_unicode_ci path '$.label' )) expected where exists(select 1 from sys_dict_data data where data.dict_type=r.resource_code and data.status='0' and (expected.expected_value is null or data.dict_value=expected.expected_value) and (expected.expected_label is null or data.dict_label=expected.expected_label))) end matched_expected_item_count from todo_foundation_resource_requirement r where r.gate_code=#{gateCode} order by r.delivery_phase,r.domain_code,r.resource_type,r.resource_code
